[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]legacy agent names can never block publication, one failing outbox [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]item can never block the others, the drain is fast enough to finish[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`SASE_AGENT` commit link resolves to a real page.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Per-item publication isolation, honest errors, and quarantine[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]permanently-stale name-registry rebuild, and reduce work done while [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]holding the sidecar lock.[/#D7D7AF]
